entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: Elder brother of Ajani Goldmane and kha of their Naya leonin tribe, renowned for his morality; killed by undead horrors.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Younger brother of Jazal, who helped him lead their pride to prosperity.

entities.name: Zaliki
entities.description: The pride-shaman who was manipulated into summoning the undead horrors that killed Jazal.

entities.name: Wild Nacatl
entities.description: A Naya leonin people, among whom Jazal questioned the divide with the Cloud Nacatl.

entities.name: Cloud Nacatl
entities.description: The people Jazal tried to reach out to.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The shard of Alara home to Jazal's leonin tribe.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The fractured plane Jazal sought to understand.

entities.name: Breaking of the Coil
entities.description: The event that divided the nacatl people.

entities.name: Festival of Marisi
entities.description: The annual festival of Jazal's pride on which he was killed.

events.summary: With his brother's help, Jazal leads his pride to prosperity and peace.
events.quote: Jazal led his pride to prosperity and peace

events.summary: Jazal tries to reach out to the Cloud Nacatl despite the divide since the Breaking of the Coil.
events.quote: even tried to reach out to the Cloud Nacatl

events.summary: Jazal is killed by undead horrors that Zaliki had been manipulated into summoning on the Festival of Marisi.
events.quote: he was killed by undead horrors

relations.quote: Jazal Goldmane was the elder brother of Ajani Goldmane

relations.note: Jazal was kha of the Naya leonin tribe.
relations.quote: the kha of their Naya leonin tribe
